title: Periodontal Treatment Response Prediction Benchmark
summary: A benchmark extension that adapts a published periodontal-treatment-response prediction study, comparing classical ML models and an MLP on synthetic versions of the original clinical trial data. The included datasetsynthesizer.py script uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata schema and constraints to generate the released synthetic internal/external clinical datasets in place of the non-public raw patient data.
